label_descriptions.exact-literal: A pattern with no metacharacters matches only an identical path; the match is anchored (no prefix/substring match). The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising a literal pattern, ideally including a non-match.
label_descriptions.star-within-segment: A single * matches zero or more characters within one segment but never matches a /. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion showing * matching within a segment AND at least one showing it does not cross a slash.
label_descriptions.doublestar-across-segments: A double star ** matches zero or more characters including /, crossing segment boundaries. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising ** spanning multiple segments.
label_descriptions.question-single-char: A ? matches exactly one character that is not a /. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising ? (including that it requires exactly one char and does not match a slash).
label_descriptions.char-class: A bracket class [abc] matches exactly one of the listed characters and never a /. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising a character class.
label_descriptions.char-class-range: A range class like [a-z] matches any single character within the range. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising a range.
label_descriptions.negated-class: A class beginning with ! ([!abc]) matches any single non-/ character not in the set. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising a negated class.
label_descriptions.escaped-metachar: A backslash escape removes the special meaning of the next character so it matches literally (e.g. \* matches a literal *). The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising an escaped metacharacter.
